Description

Familiar Island (Unofficial name) was a tiny mass of land located west of the Finlay Island. Any ores and trees that spawned on Finlay Island could be found at Familliar Island as well. The main landmark of this island was a small washed-up cabin, straight up from the older Typical Developers' title - Woodmill Inc. Touching it will yield a badge called "A Familiar Place".

To reach this island, one must locate a hatch on the shore behind the Lighthouse and traverse a long tunnel under the ocean.

This island is no longer in the game after the map destruction event, if you are looking to achieve the "A Familiar Place" badge, please go to the Secret Shack entry.

Appearance

Island mostly consists of a small grass hill and beach all around it. The only noteworthy things here are: a trapdoor acting as the entrance to said island, one of the three Key pedestals and a washed-up cabin.
